verdict.rationale: Airwallex has a first-party disputes page saying it facilitates dispute management step-by-step, so the product does handle disputes. The pack does not show how evidence is submitted or how dispute status and outcomes are tracked. missing for 10: documented structured evidence submission (fields, file uploads, API or dashboard flow), documented dispute lifecycle states and status tracking to resolution, dispute-specific webhook events, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a finance-ops user, I can respond to a chargeback with structured evidence and track the dispute lifecycle to resolution

citations.quote: Airwallex will facilitate your dispute management step-by-step, but generally does not have influence over the outcome.
